Marissa / team,

Quick guidance from finance for Nimbus’s questions:

Summary: Redwood’s standard practice under ASC 606 is to recognize revenue ratably over the service period for prepaid contracts, regardless of billing timing. That means:

- Option A (all-upfront invoice at signing): We invoice the full prepay amount, but revenue will be recognized evenly over the 36-month service term. We will provide a vendor letter confirming this treatment for your auditors.
- Option B (annual prepay-by-year): We invoice each year at the start of the relevant service year. Revenue for each invoiced year is recognized over that 12-month service period (consistent with service delivery). This is the simplest for your auditors because invoicing aligns with the recognition period.

Operational notes:
- If Nimbus requests split invoicing with Year 2/3 invoices issued earlier than 30 days before the service year, we need to record the invoices as deferred revenue and provide the SOW that explicitly ties prepay dollars to the service period.
- For any full-upfront invoice we will require a signed SOW and a PO; finance will book a deferred revenue liability and amortize monthly.
- For discount accounting: the effective discount must be documented in the SOW; we treat the discount as a contractual concession and reflect it in the revenue schedule.

Attachments: revenue_guidance_2026.pdf (internal note you can share with procurement).

If procurement needs a short letter, I can produce a one-page vendor confirmation explaining Redwood’s policy and a contact for follow-up. Suggest Marissa include a line in the SOW: "Payment schedule chosen: [All-Upfront | Annual Prepay]. Revenue recognition: Amounts invoiced are recognized ratably over the corresponding service period."

Happy to hop on a 15-min call with Nimbus finance if helpful.

Thanks,

Rishi Malhotra
